fr_html: C'est un grand honneur pour moi d'avoir été délégué par le Conseil de la Société des Nations pour ouvrir les travaux du Comité des juristes chargé de préparer le statut de la Cour Permanente de Justice Internationale.
en_html: It is a great honour for me to have been delegated by the Council of the League of Nations to open the meetings of the Committee of Jurists charged with the duty of preparing the constitution of the Permanent Court of International Justice.

en_text: It is a great honour for me to have been delegated by the Council of the League of Nations to open the meetings of the Committee of Jurists charged with the duty of preparing the constitution of the Permanent Court of International Justice.
